reviews.text:
I just wanted to write a quick review on this company because I was honestly blown away with how well my experience was with McEwan Pools.
Let me start by saying that I've ALWAYS been a skeptic of pool companies. 2 bad experiences a couple of years ago is all it took....now I'm on the defensive ANYTIME I walk into a retail pool & spa store... bc I always felt "hustled" after interactions!
That ALL changed last week when I met Jimmy McEwan, the owner of McEwan Pools. Super nice guy and EXTREMELY knowledgeable about anything that has to do with a pool. I was literally quizzing this gentleman about things that didn't even pertain to me just to try and stump him. I was not successful.
Long story short, I had a pump system I installed at my home that was costing a FORTUNE in my electric bill($450/mo, up from $200/mo after I put in the pool).... and the chemicals were costing more on top of that! After giving Mr. McEwan just a few details about the size of my pool, the pump I was using, and what chemicals I used/ how frequently I was using them, he was able to recommend a fix to the problem. I COULDNT BELIEVE THE RESULTS.
After having him install a "variable speed pump", my pool's electrical consumption was 85%-90% LESS, and the very next month, my bill was just over $200... and I ran the pump longer during the day than the old one... not to mention the almost silent motor and stronger circulation... all while running at A LOWER RPM THAN THE OLD PUMP! This is something I NEVER would've figured out on my own.... so THANK U, McEwan Pools.... and thank u Jimmy, for being the BEST at what u do! Best experience ever!
